purpose: 27 authored case blueprints = nine proposed subtypes × three approved world themes
constraints: Blueprints are ingredient proposals and do not specify actual culprit, victim, method-forensic proof, timeline, or approved NPC knowledge. None is an accepted/generated playable case until validated separately.

scenarios.investigativePremise: 204호 사건의 찌르기형(자창) 관련 감식 기록과, NPC 개인실에서 발견할 수 있는 작은 과일칼 후보의 실제 연관성을 교차 검증한다. 1층 로비 ↔ 계단 ↔ 2층 204호 복도 동선은 사건별로 입증해야 한다.

evidenceBlueprint.description: 찌름 형태에 관한 상처 감식 기록

logicConstraints: No fixed culprit or victim is assigned by this blueprint; each of 6 NPC culprits needs an independently validated truth/timeline/knowledge variation.

The selected weapon instance must be found at an NPC personal room when the player investigates; all movement before the search must be causally timed.
Do not infer the real perpetrator from owner or displayed weapon room.
Thematic record is a proposed evidence source, not an actual fact until authored scenario truth confirms existence and values.
